target_text: // One store_row per token: the owner has no raw access.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The first clause restates the name poison_plane and the two loops in the body. The one fact the body does not say is why there are 64 row stores instead of a memset: the owner exposes no raw pointer.

Proposed:
```cpp
// One store_row per token: the owner has no raw access.
```
